anti_leakage_constraint: Target variables (certified, grade, incomplete_flag, explored) must only be used as labels (y), strictly preventing data leakage into input features (X) or train/test splits.

tier_1.name: Low Risk / Likely Completer
tier_1.recommended_action: Advanced enrichment, optional peer tutoring leadership, self-directed pacing

tier_2.name: Moderate Risk / Target for Nudge
tier_2.recommended_action: Proactive check-ins, study group matchmaking, milestone reminders, assignment nudges

tier_3.name: High Risk / Early Dropout
tier_3.recommended_action: Urgent advisor outreach, onboarding diagnostic, course prerequisite remediation, technical support

supported_new_data: Later MOOC cohorts with identical non-outcome feature definitions and raw person-course schema.
incompatible_data_policy: If feature definitions or course structures change, retraining via Step 2 is mandatory.
